Cade Cunningham delivered a HISTORIC performance, dropping a season-high 52 points, 11 assists and ZERO turnovers! He becomes the first player in NBA history since the 1977-78 season to record at least 50 points and 10 assists without committing a single turnover. He also makes Detroit Pistons history as the first player in franchise history to accomplish a 50-point, 10-assist game.
